tasks.label: SIM: Compile & Run (Icarus)
tasks.command: iverilog -g2012 -o sim.vvp -I src/risc-v/alu -I src/risc-v/controller -I src/risc-v/datapath src/test/testbench.sv top.sv src/mem/*.sv src/risc-v/*.sv src/risc-v/**/*.sv src/uart/*.sv && vvp sim.vvp

tasks.label: FPGA: Build Project
tasks.command: yosys -p 'read_verilog -sv top.sv src/mem/*.sv src/risc-v/*.sv src/risc-v/**/*.sv src/uart/*.sv; synth_ice40 -top top -json ${workspaceFolderBasename}.json' && nextpnr-ice40 --up5k --package sg48 --json ${workspaceFolderBasename}.json --pcf icebreaker.pcf --asc ${workspaceFolderBasename}.asc && icepack ${workspaceFolderBasename}.asc ${workspaceFolderBasename}.bin
